subject: Add API UpdateRuntimeArgs for updating the module arguments during runtime (#1041)
reason: The change is a purely additive module API (ValkeyModule_UpdateRuntimeArgs) plus a new test module that is its only caller. No core command, reply, replication, persistence, or cluster path changes: MODULE LIST's arg display and CONFIG REWRITE's loadmodule rewriting are both unchanged and only reflect the API when a module invokes it. The sole caller is tests/modules/moduleparameter.so, which is new in this commit (so it does not exist at the parent for a compared/module_parent sequence) and is not among the test modules the runner can build (the available list has moduleconfigs.so and modulec
